description: Source code for WebSocket HTTP/3 handshake stream implementation in Chromium, handling WebSocket over HTTP/3 with connection management, request/response processing, and handshake validation.

classes.name: WebSocketHttp3HandshakeStream
classes.description: Implements WebSocket handshake over HTTP/3, managing request/response lifecycle, validation, and connection reuse.

methods.name: RegisterRequest
methods.description: Registers the HTTP request info for the handshake.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the stream with priority, net log, and timestamp.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends WebSocket handshake request headers and starts the request process.

methods.name: ReadResponseHeaders
methods.description: Reads response headers, validates response if complete.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream and disconnects adapter.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Handles received response headers, validates handshake response.

methods.name: ReceiveAdapterAndStartRequest
methods.description: Associates stream adapter and initiates request headers writing.

methods.name: ValidateResponse
methods.description: Validates the server response code and handshake success.

methods.name: ValidateUpgradeResponse
methods.description: Validates the upgrade response headers for WebSocket handshake.
